sentences.text: Eucnemesaurus is a genus of basal sauropodomorph dinosaur named for its robust tibiae.
The genus was named in 1920 by Egbert Cornelis Nicolaas van Hoepen based on holotype TM 119, the specimen the species is based on.
Remains were found by Van Hoepen in the Lower Elliot Formation on a farm in Slabberts, South Africa, dating to the Late Triassic.
Specimens of Eucnemesaurus vertebrae have been used in recent studies on the development of skeletal pneumaticity in early dinosaur genera.
